name: Ammo for Rumbleshot
summary: Gunsmith Hegnar Rumbleshot is running low on shot and powder for the riflemen practicing outside Anvilmar. A missing crate of ammunition was abandoned in the snowy wilds near the Grizzled Den when a courier was routed by hungry wendigo.

sections.title: A Courier's Flight
sections.body: Loslor Rudge at Steelgrill's Depot keeps steady supply lines flowing to tradesmen across Dun Morogh, but the valley's wildlife often interferes. His latest shipment of heavy ammunition never reached Hegnar Rumbleshot's roadside workshop. While camping near the cave system known as the Grizzled Den, the terrified courier crossed paths with local wendigo and fled for his life, abandoning the heavy wooden crate in the snow.

sections.title: Powder and Shot
sections.body: Hegnar Rumbleshot operates a gun shop situated right along the main road leading away from Anvilmar. The clearing outside his forge sees constant traffic from Ironforge riflemen, mountaineers, and dwarven mortar squads looking to zero their sights and drill with live fire. Without steady crates of powder and lead from suppliers like Loslor, the riflemen's marksmanship training quickly grinds to a dead stop.

faq.q: Where was the ammo crate lost?
faq.answer: Loslor Rudge's frightened courier dropped the shipment while encamped just outside the Grizzled Den, a wendigo-infested cave nestled in the snowy hills southwest of Kharanos.
Hegnar Rumbleshot is a dwarven gunsmith who runs a weapon shop along the road near Anvilmar. He supplies powder, bullets, and firearms to the mountaineers, hunters, and siege teams drilling nearby.

faq.q: Why was the courier chased off?
faq.answer: The courier made the mistake of camping near the Grizzled Den, the den of the savage, territorial wendigo that roam the hills southwest of Kharanos.

faq.q: Why is Hegnar Rumbleshot out of ammunition?
faq.answer: Dwarven riflemen and mortar teams constantly burn through powder and lead practicing target drills near Hegnar's shop, keeping his inventory in high demand.
Loslor Rudge is a dwarven engineering supplier at Steelgrill's Depot whose business ships ammunition to Hegnar Rumbleshot.

faq.q: Does recovered ammunition spoil in the snow?
faq.answer: Dwarven munitions are traditionally packed in heavy, weather-sealed wooden crates to keep black powder dry and ready to burn even in Dun Morogh's sub-zero blizzards.

angles.text: Every marksman in Coldridge knows Hegnar's shop well; keeping his shelves stocked with fresh powder and shot ensures you never face the wilderness with an empty rifle.
Dwarven craftsmanship relies on an unyielding supply chain between Anvilmar's smithies and frontline gunsmiths like Rumbleshot.
Dwarven firearms and mortars demand finely milled powder and uniform shot, making Rumbleshot's inventory essential for local tinkerers and gunners.
